1.c4 e5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.Nf3 Nc6 4.g3 Bc5 5.d.strategy: Controls e4, so the attacking push ...e4 can no longer drive the knight away, and frees the c1 bishop. White chooses a solid, flexible set-up and keeps the central break for later; in return Black has time to organise his pieces freely.

Supports e5 and the c5 bishop in a single move and opens the diagonal of the c8 bishop. Black chooses a compact structure that is hard to attack, and the game becomes a slow manoeuvring one with chances for both sides.
